fact: In a custody case of November 2023 at the commissariat of the 12th arrondissement of Cotonou, the Constitutional Court set the times in arrest procès-verbal n°407/23 against those in the commissariat's registre de la main courante, and the applicant cited its registre des plaintes; the decision names station registers and does not say whether they are paper or digital.
title: Décision DCC du 20 février 2025 (fichier DCC5-050_20_fevrier_2025.pdf)
